# Jiangshan phase and administrative schematic data notices (V7)

Source-phase political and administrative schematics from https://github.com/haitaowu12/jiangshan-map, commit `fcd6484d06d3c581241fc24adbab288cf3a4a2ea`, `js/atlas_snapshots.js`. Original author: DeanChensj, 2026.

The source README declares GPL-3.0 and describes these outlines as schematic approximations. Its root LICENSE is MIT. Both notices are retained: the full GPL-3.0 text is supplied as `territories.LICENSE`; the MIT notice follows below. This is not a claim that each upstream third-party reference is MIT licensed. The source cites CHGIS, Hartwell, Tan Qixiang and historical-basemaps, but does not identify a derivation source for each outline. No CHGIS dataset was downloaded or redistributed in this supplement. Per-outline provenance remains unresolved and should be documented in future source contributions.

Modifications: extracted 166 original source display phases over 18 period windows; retained only main/rival political features, omitting repeated static neighbor templates and protectorates; deduplicated feature geometry; translated names with original reference dictionary; separated administrative geometry into optional per-period chunks; attached source phase intervals and inherited review status. No frontier redrawing, interpolation, or independent boundary reconstruction. GeoJSON winding is normalized by the consuming atlas renderer. Modern source snapshot s_prc is empty and is not replaced with an invented historical outline. Source-defined period windows are not claimed to be dynasty lifespans.
